views.markdown:
A rewrite of Kyle Howells' SwipeSelection.

Swipe along the keyboard to move the cursor and select text.

* move the cursor at the speed you set.
* feel each cursor step with optional haptic feedback.
* select from Shift, Delete or keys you choose.
* work in the color picker's hex field.
* tested on iOS 16, 17 & 26.

* fix Selection Keys on the Thai keyboard, where a vowel mark could not be removed.
* press Delete while adding Selection Keys to remove the last key added.
* show the Cursor Speed value on iOS 26.
* @sahinkaa thanks for reporting and testing.

* fix the edit menu staying on screen after cut, copy or delete on iOS 26.
* show the edit menu again after a short swipe right after another.
* add Show Menu After Selecting to turn the menu after a swipe off.
* list tested iOS versions in the description.
* @sahinkaa thanks for reporting and testing.

* fix a quick tap on Delete removing two characters on iOS 26.
* @sahinkaa thanks for reporting and testing.
* fix the settings header showing the wrong build scheme.

* show the package icon after install.
* add a Tip on Ko-fi row to the credits.
* name the original first in the description.
* credit Kyle Howells' SwipeSelection in the description.
